eyebrow: The costs nobody puts on the slide

steps.label: LATENCY
steps.sub: Each step, a full round trip

code:
Does this need info found through MULTIPLE steps,
where later steps depend on earlier results?

  NO               -> one prompt is enough
  YES, fixed order -> a workflow (your code decides the path)
  YES, order varies -> a real agent loop
caption: Only the last case actually needs what Chapter 1 just taught.

code:
"Summarize this doc"       -> one pass, already in context
"Email the weekly report
   to the same 3 people"    -> fixed workflow, never varies
"Classify this ticket
   into 5 categories"       -> one direct prompt, reliably
caption: All three would work through a loop — and all three would just be slower.
